# Numi-OT.01

Motor Numi OT de Numination.

```bash
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt && pip install -e .
python scripts/training/train_sft.py --config configs/training/sft_mid.yaml
python scripts/serve.py
```

API compatible con OpenAI chat completions.
